description:
Validate a Dutch KVK number (Handelsregister)

Validates an 8-digit KVK number against the official KVK Handelsregister
API (developers.kvk.nl). Current data is always fetched from KVK; the local
cache (48 hours) only serves repeated requests. `lastFetchedAt` shows when the
data was last retrieved from KVK. Optional: `?vies=true` or `?vat=true`
validates the derived VAT number via VIES (free, extra latency). Returns
whether the registration is active,
its legal form (rechtsvorm), the start date and the SBI-activities. It does
**not** expose company names, full addresses or other personal data.

KVK rate-limits this endpoint to 1 request per minute per IP, so results are
cached for 48 hours. When KVK is unreachable we return HTTP 502/503.

Cost: 1 credit(s) per call. An API key is required via the X-Api-Key header (or Authorization: Bearer <key>); a per-call wallet payment via x402 is also accepted.
name: validation.kvk
